articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Trump reveals up to $100K Strategy stock purchase in ethics filing
articles.description: President Donald Trump disclosed a July purchase of Strategy shares as his administration continues to advance crypto policy through federal regulators and Congress.

articles.title: US stablecoin adoption could surge with bank-like protections: Visa survey
articles.description: The survey released by Visa posited that bank-like protections for stablecoins could increase adoption in the US as companies are preparing for the enactment of the GENIUS Act.

articles.title: Bitwise launches first Lighter ETP amid Hyperliquid rivalry
articles.description: The product gives European investors brokerage access to the LIT token as Bitwise expands its lineup of products tied to decentralized derivatives platforms.

articles.title: NYSE, Blockchain.com in tie-up to bring tokenized US stocks to crypto users
articles.description: Blockchain.com users could gain access to tokenized US stocks and ETFs through NYSE’s planned digital trading platform under a new partnership, as bourses rush to deliver new trading.

articles.title: Bitcoin long liquidations hit $280M as BTC price dips under $84K
articles.description: Bitcoin long liquidations mounted as BTC/USD briefly traded below $84,000, while analysis flagged key support to hold.

articles.title: Raiffeisen to offer crypto trading across 11 European markets via Bitpanda
articles.description: Bitpanda will provide crypto infrastructure to Raiffeisen network banks, potentially extending digital asset access to about 18 million customers.

articles.title: ESMA to prioritize EU-wide AI and tokenization supervision in 2027
articles.description: National regulators will map client-facing uses of the technologies, check a subset of firms and develop common approaches to oversight.

articles.title: Winners and losers of the SEC’s new tokenized stocks rules
articles.description: The SEC has opened a five-year path for tokenized stocks, but only some products and venues fit the model. Will Uniswap, Robinhood, Coinbase or Kraken come out on top?

articles.title: MoonPay to buy North Capital in all-stock deal worth over $60M
articles.description: MoonPay’s North Capital acquisition adds US broker-dealer, trading and investment infrastructure as it expands into tokenized securities.

articles.title: Stablecoin cross-border flows surge 78%, defying crypto bear market
articles.description: Cross-border stablecoin transfers surged as the wider crypto market shrank 37%, with Chainalysis pointing to growing use for trade, remittances and savings.

articles.title: EU watchdogs warn quantum computers could pick crypto’s locks
articles.description: EU supervisors warn quantum computing could weaken blockchain security as Bitcoin developers weigh a draft migration plan and Ethereum targets 2029.

articles.title: CFTC chair pushes tokenization as SEC opens door to onchain stocks
articles.description: Michael Selig said tokenization could reshape financial markets as the CFTC and SEC continue advancing onchain initiatives despite the CLARITY Act setback.

articles.title: Bitcoin bull market ‘confirmed’ but $90K presents profit-taking risk: Analysis
articles.description: BTC price analysis concluded that onchain signals had “confirmed” the new Bitcoin bull market.

articles.title: BitMEX ends crypto trading, keeps withdrawals open after closure
articles.description: BitMEX officially ended exchange operations after more than 11 years, while withdrawals remain open as the crypto derivatives platform urges users to remove their funds.

articles.title: Zcash’s November upgrade could freeze funds in legacy Sprout pool
articles.description: The proposed NU7 change would disable version 4 transactions, leaving ZEC in Zcash’s legacy Sprout shielded pool unspendable.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs take in $1.7B in 2 days as BTC tops holder cost basis
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded more than $1.7 billion in net inflows over two days as Bitcoin rose above investors’ estimated average cost basis.

articles.title: US Treasury secretary emerges as frontrunner for Trump’s AI czar role: Report
articles.description: US President Donald Trump previously tapped David Sacks as his AI and crypto czar before Sacks stepped down from the role earlier this year after reaching his service limit as a special government employee.

articles.title: Malicious iOS app FomoPeek linked to $580K crypto theft, SlowMist says
articles.description: SlowMist said malicious FomoPeek versions distributed through Apple’s App Store used iOS kernel exploits to escape the sandbox and access sensitive data from other apps.

articles.title: AI potential to drive crypto demand remains ‘underappreciated’: BlackRock
articles.description: BlackRock says AI agents could drive demand for stablecoins and programmable payment rails, while tokenized computing capacity could create another opportunity for digital assets.

articles.title: OpenAI, Anthropic to brief UN Security Council on AI risks: Reports
articles.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman are expected to brief the UN Security Council as it examines AI risks and global security.

articles.title: CFTC issues warning over risky prediction market ‘mention’ contracts
articles.description: The warning comes weeks after the CFTC fined a former White House teleprompter operator who made more than $107,000 trading prediction contracts tied to President Trump’s speeches.

articles.title: Arch Lending eyes tokenized stocks as next collateral market
articles.description: Arch Lending’s Himanshu Sahay said on Cointelegraph’s Chain Reaction podcast that the lender plans to move into tokenized equities as onchain stocks gain traction as collateral.

articles.title: Republican senator calls for probe into US presidents’ sons, citing crypto ventures
articles.description: Many Democrats have previously called for investigations into the Trump family’s crypto ventures, but now a Republican is asking for an inquiry based on ties to the presidency.

articles.title: Canada’s six largest banks explore tokenized Canadian dollar deposits
articles.description: The country’s largest financial institutions are exploring tokenized deposits for interbank payments, just weeks after regulators clarified how they should be treated.

articles.title: Zcash gets first European ETP following US ETF launch
articles.description: 21shares listed physically backed ZEC and ETHFI products on Euronext Paris and Amsterdam, as issuers broaden their offerings beyond major cryptocurrencies.

articles.title: Bitcoin price seeks $86K as new support after oil dips below $90
articles.description: Bitcoin price action avoided a significant drop below $86,000 as US president Donald Trump pledged a deal with Iran after November’s midterm election.

articles.title: CLARITY vote failure could stoke more crypto PAC spending in key races
articles.description: Control of the US House and Senate is up for grabs in 2026, and some advocates speculate that the crypto industry could ratchet up attempts to sway elections after the CLARITY vote.

articles.title: ECB, EU cenbanks seek changes in MiCA’s minimum bank deposit for stablecoins
articles.description: The ECB and EU central banks want to replace MiCA’s stablecoin bank-deposit requirements with liquidity thresholds, warning that sudden withdrawals could strain lenders.

articles.title: Big Questions: Does Satoshi actually own 1.1 million Bitcoin?
articles.description: Researchers can trace an estimated 1.1 million BTC to a distinctive early mining operation. The harder question is whether that miner was actually Satoshi.
